question.text:
Consider the following rule: an identifier must start with a digit and can be followed by any number of letters or digits. What is the correct regular expression?

  1. letter (letter $\mid$ digit)$^{*}$
     
  2. (digit $\mid$ letter)$^{*}$ digit
     
  3. digit (digit $\mid$ letter)$^{*}$
     
  4. digit$^{+}$ letter$^{*}$
question.subject: Programming in Python

question.text:
Consider the following Three-Address Code $(3AC)$ sequence. Partition the code into basic blocks and determine the total number of blocks.
\[
\begin{array}{ll}
\textbf{Line No.} & \textbf{Instruction} \\
3001 & \verb|i = 1| \\
3002 & \verb|j = 1| \\
3003 & \verb|t1 = i * 10| \\
3004 & \verb|t2 = t1 + j| \\
3005 & \verb|if t2 < 100 goto 3008| \\
3006 & \verb|a[t2] = 0| \\
3007 & \verb|goto 3009| \\
3008 & \verb|a[t2] = 1| \\
3009 & \verb|j = j + 1| \\
3010 & \verb|if j <= 10 goto 3003| \\
3011 & \verb|i = i + 1| \\
3012 & \verb|if i <= 10 goto 3002| \\
3013 & \verb|t3 = i - 1| \\
3014 & \verb|if t3 == 0 goto 3017| \\
3015 & \verb|res = a[t3]| \\
3016 & \verb|goto 3018| \\
3017 & \verb|res = -1| \\
3018 & \verb|return res| \\
\end{array}
\]
THE NUMBER OF BASIC BLOCKS IS $\_\_\_\_$ . (Answer in integer)
question.subject: Programming in Python

question.text:
Consider the following grammar $G$ with terminal set $\{i d, \&, \oplus, \odot,()$,$\} :$

  • $E::=E \& T \mid T$
     
  • $T::=F \oplus T \mid F$
     
  • $F::=F \odot i d|(E)| i d$
     

Which of the following statements is TRUE regarding the operators $\&$, $\oplus$, and $\odot$ ?

  1. ALL THREE OPERATORS ARE LEFT ASSOCIATIVE
     
  2. '$\&$' AND '$\odot$' ARE LEFT ASSOCIATIVE, WHILE '$\oplus$' IS RIGHT ASSOCIATIVE
     
  3. '$\&$' IS RIGHT ASSOCIATIVE, WHILE ' $\oplus$ ' AND ' $\odot$ ' ARE LEFT ASSOCIATIVE
     
  4. '$\&$' HAS THE HIGHEST PRECEDENCE AND IS LEFT ASSOCIATIVE
question.subject: Programming in Python

question.text:
In the following grammar defining operations on identifiers:

  • $A::=B \# A \mid B$
     
  • $B::=B \diamond C \mid C$
     
  • $C::=i d$
     

Which of the following is TRUE?

  1. BOTH '$\#$' AND '$\diamond$' ARE LEFT ASSOCIATIVE
     
  2. BOTH '$\#$' AND '$\diamond$' ARE RIGHT ASSOCIATIVE
     
  3. '$\#$' IS LEFT ASSOCIATIVE WHILE '$\diamond$' IS RIGHT ASSOCIATIVE
     
  4. '$\#$' IS RIGHT ASSOCIATIVE WHILE '$\diamond$' IS LEFT ASSOCIATIVE
question.subject: Programming in Python

question.text:
Refer to the given $3$-address code sequence below. If this code sequence is split into basic blocks, determine the total number of basic blocks.

\[
\begin{array}{ll}
\textbf{Line No.} & \textbf{Instruction} \\
2001 & \verb|sum = 0| \\
2002 & \verb|i = 1| \\
2003 & \verb|j = 1| \\
2004 & \verb|t1 = i * 4| \\
2005 & \verb|t2 = a[t1]| \\
2006 & \verb|sum = sum + t2| \\
2007 & \verb|j = j + 1| \\
2008 & \verb|if j <= 20 goto 2004| \\
2009 & \verb|i = i + 1| \\
2010 & \verb|if i <= 10 goto 2003| \\
2011 & \verb|k = 1| \\
2012 & \verb|t3 = k * 8| \\
2013 & \verb|b[t3] = 0| \\
2014 & \verb|k = k + 1| \\
2015 & \verb|if k <= 5 goto 2012| \\
2016 & \verb|return sum| \\
\end{array}
\]
The number of basic blocks is $\_\_\_\_$ . (Answer in integer)
question.subject: Programming in Python
